name: evalgate
description: Portable EvalGate workflows for behavioral-change analysis, evaluation evidence, regression gates, traces, and repository questions.

interface.longDescription: Use EvalGate to discover evaluation files, run local regression gates, collect bounded traces, and ask evidence-backed questions about a connected repository. Cloud workflows require an explicitly provisioned scoped API key.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run the safest EvalGate workflow for this repository.
